race.title: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: NOBODY TOLD ME is selected to make a winning start for new trainer Dan Skelton, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Yourcardismarked has also been the subject of an interesting trainer change and support for him would make him a potentially dangerous opponent. Laplander should be up to doing something off this mark based on Flat ability, while it would also be no surprise were Cheap Sandwiches to prove a different proposition in handicaps. NOBODY TOLD ME YOURCARDISMARKED (IRE) LAPLANDER
race.bettingForecast: Nobody Told Me (10/3), Dino Bellagio (6/1), Gaelic Glow (8/1), Everest (8/1), Cheap Sandwiches (10/1), Milady Du Breuil (10/1), Tenadaay (10/1), Yourcardismarked (12/1), Laplander (12/1), Orbys River (14/1), Little Lady Lucy (16/1), On Subs (16/1), Troy Story (20/1), Trackman (33/1)
